title: Vesper and the Ledger
author: Vesper Delacroix
blurb: Cyrus Blackwood, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
